title: Expiry of Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
# Expiry

**Clause.** A plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans expires when its term ends while visits remain. The term ends at whichever of these happens first:
- the end of the expiration date; or
- the first visit or check-in whose odometer is above the expiration odometer plus the plan's grace miles.

A plan is expired only from active status. Visits unused at expiry are removed by one expiry entry on the plan ledger. No plan refunds visits left unused at expiration, so unused visits at expiry are never refunded or extended. A plan whose last visit has been redeemed is fulfilled, not expired.

## Outcome table

| Plan state when the term ends | Result |
|---|---|
| Active, visits remaining | Expired; the remaining visits are removed in one entry; no refund, no extension |
| Last visit already redeemed | Fulfilled, not expired |
| Already cancelled, fulfilled or expired | Not expired again; expiry is made only from active status |

Hypothetical illustration: a plan with a hypothetical expiration odometer of 40,000 and 1000 grace miles expires at the first check-in recorded above 41,000, if that comes before the end of its expiration date. A check-in at exactly 41,000 does not end the term.
